Quest._currentObjective: Find Linus' basket and return it to him.
Quest._questDescription: It's blackberry season, but Linus can't find his basket! He's asking you to help him find it. He has no idea where it is.
Caroline wants to carve a pumpkin with her daughter. She asked you to bring her one from the farm.
Quest.targetMessage: Oh, the pumpkin! It's a good one... Abigail will be so happy when she sees this. Thanks, @!$h

Quest._questDescription: You encountered a suspicious looking figure by the bus stop. When it saw you, it fled toward town. Could there be a clue to its whereabouts?
Willy is challenging you to catch a squid. He says you can fish them from the ocean on winter nights.
Quest.targetMessage: Hey, you did it! Not bad. Not bad at all. I'm impressed.#$b#Winter's a good time to break out the old fishing rod, isn't it?

Quest._questDescription: Clint wants you to give Emily an amethyst. He wants you to tell her it's from him.
Quest.targetMessage: Oh, my favorite stone! You're so sweet!$h#$b#Huh? It's from who?$u#$b#Oh, you got it at Clint's? Well I don't care where you got it from, it's beautiful! Thank you! *smooch*$h

Quest._questDescription: Gus wants to make fish stew, but he needs an albacore.
Quest.targetMessage: *sniff*...*sniff*... What's that? Something smells like albacore!#$b#Aha! You brought it! Thanks a million!

Quest._questDescription: Evelyn wants to surprise her husband with a gift.
Quest.targetMessage: Oh, thank you, dear. This leek looks delicious. George will be so happy.#$b#He loves when I make eggs with leeks for breakfast.

Quest._questDescription: The big tree to the south of my farm blew down. With 100 hardwood, I could turn the stump into something interesting...
Pierre will pay "top coin" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Apparently he's really craving the stuff.
Quest.targetMessage: It's about time! I was starting to get the shakes, I wanted this fish so bad. *munch*... Mmm, now that's good.#$b#Thanks, @.$h

Quest._questDescription: Kent wants to give his wife a starfruit for their anniversary.
Quest.targetMessage: Hey. Shhh... Don't let Jodi see.#$b#Ah, this looks juicy. She'll love it. Thank you so much.$h

Quest._currentObjective: Bring Lewis a bottle of Truffle Oil.
Quest._questDescription: Mayor Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business.
Quest.targetMessage: You got the oil? Let me see...#$b#It's high quality... very slick. Great. Thank you.

Quest._questDescription: Gus put out a notice requesting a fresh lobster.
Quest.targetMessage: Something smells like fresh lobster. Oh, that's good.$h#$b#Take care, friend.

Quest._currentObjective: Enter the sewer and ask Krobus about the dark talisman.
Quest._questDescription: The Wizard asked me to retrieve the magic ink from his ex-wife's house... but to gain access I'll need a dark talisman.
Pam's TV Remote is dead. She's having a tough time going back and forth between the couch and the TV dial.
Quest.targetMessage: Hey, you pulled through with the battery pack! Thanks, kid... You're a life-saver!$h

Quest._currentObjective: Reach the bottom of the mine.
Quest._questDescription: So far, there's no sign of the bottom. How low does it go?
The Wizard is creating a staff of phenomenal power. Who knows what it's for. He needs an iridium bar to finish it.
Quest.targetMessage: Ah, precious iridium. You've done well, @. You have my gratitude. Now, leave.
